body: India survivorship-free re-test (489 company-snapshots, FY16/FY18; weighted failure base 19.7%): S1 lift 2.20 [0.50,4.42] (13 flagged), S5-India 1.985 [1.01,3.24], S2 1.69 [1.27,2.20] (2.87 on liquidation/compulsory exit), S4 none, S3 none. None passes the pre-set bar in India alone, but direction matches the US. Graded red only means look harder + size smaller (cheap if wrong), so keep S1/S5 graded red with label 'India unproven'. Re-test with FY2014/FY2020 snapshots or full live+delisted lists. Known gap: unlabeled dead-bank pages can slip past is_financial() in the live screen.
title: India: keep S1 and S5-India as graded red (US-proven, India consistent but unproven); S2 a strong question
